seychelles-ultra-luxury-island-hopper.lead: Three distinct addresses in ten days, from Eden Island’s superyacht marina to Raffles on Praslin and Anantara Maia, with marine park days in between.

reasons.d: A marina-front suite at Eden Bleu, a panoramic pool villa at Raffles Seychelles, then an all-inclusive villa at Anantara Maia.

A full-day catamaran cruise through Ste Anne Marine National Park among coral reefs and turtles, a glass-bottom boat, and snorkelling around the granite islet of St Pierre for reef sharks and eagle rays.
Anse Lazio, one of the world’s finest beaches, a hidden forest trail to Anse Georgette, and a scenic drive through Morne Seychellois’s cloud forests.

seychelles-wild-adventure.lead: The Seychelles for people who like to walk, snorkel and fly: granite summit trails, marine parks and five days on Félicité.

reasons.d: The Copolia Trail climbs 180 metres in 1.2 km to a summit ledge above the treeline, past pitcher plants and endemic upland forest in Morne Seychellois National Park.
Sainte Anne’s six islands with Moyenne’s free-roaming tortoises, sheltered Port Launay for first-time snorkellers, diving, and paragliding over Beau Vallon Bay.
Six Senses Zil Pasyon on the private island of Félicité, with a day of adventure on La Digue.

seychelles-wild-outer-island-explorer.lead: Beyond the main islands: a charter flight to Alphonse Atoll for fly-fishing, diving with mantas and a day on an uninhabited atoll.

reasons.d: A one-hour charter flight south to Alphonse, where a sunset beach bonfire briefing with the resident marine biologists begins your stay at Alphonse Island Lodge.
Guided fly-fishing across expansive sand flats for bonefish, milkfish and giant trevally.
Scuba diving Alphonse’s outer reef walls alongside manta rays and hammerhead sharks, and a skiff to uninhabited St François Atoll with a picnic on an open sandbank.

srilanka-ancient-northern-kingdoms-reefs.lead: Sri Lanka’s quieter north: leopards in Wilpattu, 2,000-year-old Anuradhapura, then Jaffna and Delft Island, where wild horses roam the ruins of a Dutch fort.

reasons.d: Leopard tracking in Wilpattu National Park, where leopards and sloth bears patrol the natural sand basins, from a private pool villa at Uga Ulagalla.
The 2,000-year-old Ruwanwelisaya Stupa and the sacred Bodhi Tree, and a sundowner from a private stone platform overlooking the ancient carvings.
Crossing Elephant Pass to Jaffna and the golden spires of Nallur Kandaswamy, then a private speedboat to Delft Island’s coral-stone Dutch fort and its herds of wild horses.

srilanka-cultural-triangle-apex-wilds.lead: Sigiriya, Polonnaruwa and the Minneriya elephant gathering, then the east coast for blue whales.

reasons.d: Climbing Sigiriya past the giant carved Lion’s Paws to the 5th-century royal palace and its frescoes, and a dawn balloon over the rock monoliths.

The Minneriya Gathering, with hundreds of wild Asian elephants around the ancient reservoir, a champagne sundowner from an open-top vehicle, and Polonnaruwa’s Gal Vihara Buddhas carved from a single granite boulder.
A deep-sea blue whale safari from Trincomalee, Pigeon Island Marine Sanctuary, and the clifftop Koneswaram temple.

srilanka-tea-highlands-whales-south.lead: Tea estates in the highlands, the Nine Arch Bridge and blue whales off Mirissa: three Sri Lankas in ten days.

reasons.d: Ceylon Tea Trails, a historic colonial-style estate, with a hands-on tea plucking and tasting masterclass and a Castlereagh Lake sundowner of single malts and single-estate Ceylon teas.
The golden-roofed Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic in Kandy, and the Nine Arch Bridge at Ella with the historic steam train crossing it.
A private 55-foot catamaran from Mirissa tracking wild blue whales and pods of spinner dolphins, then Sinharaja’s rainforest and a walk around the UNESCO fort at Galle.

zanzibar-island-savannah-romance.lead: Zanzibar’s dolphins and sandbars, then a flight to Kilimanjaro and a wildlife lodge: island romance with a savannah finish.

reasons.d: A candle-lit rooftop dinner over the old minarets, from the Sultanate Ocean Suite at Park Hyatt Zanzibar.

reasons.t: Dolphins, a sandbar and a sea walk
reasons.d: A dawn dhow among wild bottlenose and humpback dolphins, a white-linen breakfast on a disappearing sandbar, a walk on the reef floor, and lunch at The Rock restaurant.
A direct flight to Mount Kilimanjaro and the Serval Wildlife Resort, with free-roaming wildlife and movies under the stars.

zanzibar-palatial-stone-town-coral-atoll.lead: Stone Town’s history with a private historian, then a private atoll: Mnemba Island with &Beyond.

reasons.d: A private historian leads the slave market site and Christ Church Cathedral, followed by Prison Island’s giant Aldabra tortoises, some over 100 years old.

reasons.t: From above and from a sandbar
reasons.d: A dawn helicopter loop over Stone Town’s rooftops and Jozani’s canopy, and a vintage wine sundowner on a private sandbar.
&Beyond Mnemba Island Lodge is a private atoll with white-sand beaches and clear snorkelling, with a private boat to the marine reserve’s spinner dolphins and coral drop-offs.

zanzibar-secret-oases-hidden-sandbars.lead: The quiet south and east of Zanzibar: wild dolphins at dawn, a sacred cave, mangroves and a lunch on a rock in the sea.

reasons.d: A morning dhow among humpback and bottlenose dolphins, then the Kuza Cave’s limestone pools, used for centuries for spiritual healing, and a carpet-and-majlis sundowner above the valley.
A private dhow through Jozani Chwaka Bay’s calm mangrove channels, and a Safari Blue expedition to hidden reefs, a mangrove lagoon swim and a sandbar seafood feast.
A private, crowd-free lunch at The Rock restaurant on its lone coral outcrop, and quiet days on the Michamvi Peninsula.

zanzibar-southern-marine-dolphin-sanctua.lead: Stone Town’s history, Jozani’s red colobus monkeys and the southern dolphin coast, with a sea walk on the reef.

reasons.d: A private historian leads the Old Arab Fort and House of Wonders, followed by a rooftop sundowner as the sun drops behind the old minarets.
Jozani Chwaka Bay National Park, where rare Zanzibar red colobus monkeys leap through the mahogany canopy.
A dawn dhow to Kizimkazi Bay for wild humpback and bottlenose dolphins, a white-linen breakfast on a disappearing sandbar, and a reef sea walk that needs no diving experience.

zanzibar-spice-coast-ancient-kingdoms.lead: Stone Town’s palaces and a century-old spice estate, then the Nungwi coast by dhow, with turtles and a reef walk.

reasons.d: A private tour of a century-old spice estate, with cloves, nutmeg, cinnamon and vanilla vines and Zanzibar’s spice trade explained.
A private historian leads the Arab Fort, the Sultan’s Palace ruins and the House of Wonders.

reasons.t: Dhow, turtles and a reef walk
reasons.d: A handcrafted private dhow around the Nungwi Peninsula with loggerhead turtles and a champagne brunch in a tidal reef cove, plus a sea walk on the northern outer reef.

zanzibar-ultimate-sultans-archipelago.lead: Zanzibar and Pemba in one journey, ending in a bedroom beneath the sea at The Manta Resort.

reasons.d: The Manta Resort’s Underwater Room has glass bedroom windows looking straight into the ocean, with coral fish and sea turtles drifting past.
A deep-sea wall walk in the Pemba Channel wearing a diving helmet, and a private hike through the Ngezi Rainforest to see Pemba flying foxes, ending with a rainforest stream breakfast.
Stone Town’s sultanate palaces, Jozani’s red colobus monkeys, Kuza Cave’s sacred pools and a private lunch at The Rock.
